rationale:
Positives: The agent correctly verified identity via full name + ZIP and matched the account. It located the correct Texas-shipped order (#W5565470) and asked for explicit confirmation before initiating any returns. When the user requested a human, the agent handed off appropriately.

Failures: The agent provided a specific tracking number (907614527588) for order #W5565470 without tool evidence in the transcript to support it (the get_order_details output was truncated and did not show fulfillments/tracking). This violates the policy against fabricating or stating unsupported information. The agent also stated the refund would go to PayPal without confirming the order’s payment method from the order’s payment history (only the user’s stored methods were checked), which is another unsupported assertion. Since providing accurate tracking and refund information is central to the user’s request, these issues cause the interaction to fail the pass bar despite the correct verification and proper handoff.
